subject: geography
title: Culture regions, language, and religion
objective: Describe how culture spreads and how regions are defined.

lesson.opening: Culture is the shared way of life of a group: language, religion, food, and custom. Culture regions are areas that share these traits.

sections.heading: Culture regions
sections.body: A culture region is an area with shared cultural traits. Boundaries are usually fuzzy and overlap, unlike political borders.

sections.heading: Language
sections.body: Languages belong to families that share a common ancestor, such as the Romance languages descended from Latin. Languages spread by migration, trade, and empire.

sections.heading: Diffusion
sections.body: Cultural traits spread by relocation (people carry them) or expansion (they spread outward from a source).

activities.prompt: A culture region is an area that shares…
choices: Cultural traits such as language and custom

activities.prompt: Spanish, French, and Italian belong to which language family?
Diffusion in which people carry a trait to a new place is…
Explain how one cultural trait spreads between places.
activities.context: Relocation diffusion moves with people; expansion diffusion spreads outward from a source.
